news.headline: BlackRock reports 6.4% stake in Tenax Therapeutics (TENX)
Evercore ISI initiates Tenax Therapeutics stock coverage with outperform rating
news.summary: Evercore ISI began coverage of TENX with an Outperform rating and a $39 price target, assigning roughly 50% probability of success to the Phase 3 LEVEL trial while noting the current share price implies only 20-25% odds. The firm sees potential upside ranging from 250% to 10x on positive data, against significant downside if the trial fails.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics CEO exercises stock options, acquires 8,719 shares
news.summary: CEO Christopher Thomas Giordano exercised stock options on July 13, 2026 to acquire 8,719 common shares, including 8,500 shares at $5.94 per share and 219 shares at $3.549 per share, according to an SEC Form 4 filing.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Late-Breaking Presentation of LEVEL Clinical Trial Data at ESC Congress 2026
news.summary: Tenax announced that topline Phase 3 LEVEL trial results for TNX-103 (oral levosimendan) in PH-HFpEF will be unveiled in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the ESC Congress 2026 in Munich (Aug 28-31), presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah of Northwestern University. This sharpens the data timeline to a specific August 2026 window rather than a general Q3 guide.

news.headline: Tenax and Orion secure long-term levosimendan supply deal, extend license through 2035
news.summary: Orion Corporation exercised its option to become primary manufacturer/supplier of oral levosimendan under a new five-year Supply Agreement with automatic renewals, and the parties amended their 2013 License Agreement to extend the deadline for U.S. regulatory approval to December 31, 2035.

news.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald reiterates Tenax Therapeutics stock Overweight rating
news.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Olivia Brayer Saunders reiterated an Overweight rating and $35 price target on TENX, noting renewed investor interest ahead of the Phase 3 LEVEL data expected in Q3 2026.

news.headline: Guggenheim raises Tenax Therapeutics price target to $40, lifts trial success odds to 80%
news.summary: Guggenheim maintained its Buy rating on TENX and raised its price target to $40 from $34, while increasing its probability-of-success estimate for the Phase 3 LEVEL trial to 80% from 75%. The firm noted Tenax is the only company running a Phase 3 trial in PH-HFpEF, a condition with no approved treatments.

catalysts.label: LEVEL Phase 3 data presented at ESC Congress 2026
catalysts.detail: Late-breaking Clinical Science session in Munich will present full topline results of the Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF, presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah.

catalysts.label: LEVEL trial database lock and topline readout
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for database lock, statistical analysis, and topline data disclosure on the primary 6-minute walk distance endpoint during Q3 2026, aligning with the ESC presentation.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings / corporate update
catalysts.detail: Third-party estimates point to Tenax reporting second-quarter 2026 financial results and a corporate update around August 13, 2026; the company has not issued an official press release confirming the date.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 global trial enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: The global, ex-US LEVEL-2 registrational trial of oral levosimendan in PH-HFpEF is ongoing, with enrollment completion targeted by the end of 2027 ahead of a potential NDA filing.

pulse: Tenax Therapeutics is in the final stretch before its make-or-break Phase 3 LEVEL readout for oral levosimendan in PH-HFpEF, with data now specifically slated for a late-breaking ESC Congress presentation on August 29, 2026. Sell-side sentiment has turned increasingly bullish into the catalyst, with Evercore ISI initiating at Outperform, Guggenheim lifting its probability-of-success estimate to 80%, and Cantor Fitzgerald and others reiterating bullish targets, while insider option exercises by the CEO and a new long-term Orion supply agreement (license extended to 2035) add further confidence signals. With roughly $118.8M in cash funding operations into 2028, the stock remains essentially a binary bet on the August data, trading near its 52-week highs heading into the readout.
